blocker.summary: IMPORTANT REVISION: the r399-r432 chain was previously reported CLOSED with 'no known blocker', but r435 found that claim is no longer reliable for a full-length run. r434 found PinnedShaderRuntime (the real Vulkan rendering engine, r256-r270) is never wired to the live VdSwap path, and its shared-memory SSBO uses a bounded 64 MiB direct-address-as-offset window sized for synthetic test addresses. r435 added diagnostic tracing (native_guest_vd.cpp, gated behind AC6_NATIVE_VD_TRACE, kept committed) and captured real DrawPacket data live: index_address/vertex_address are always 0x00000000 (real draws are auto-indexed, not DMA-indexed), and fetch_const[0] carries the real vertex fetch address -- observed values like 0x1274027b, 0x126c01df, around 310 MiB, far outside the 64 MiB window. This confirms r434's concern with measured values. Separately and more urgently: while capturing this, a probe-entry launch (AC6_NATIVE_ALLOW_ENTRY_PROBE=1, 25s window) crashed with SIGSEGV in generated PPC code (__imp__sub_821D6C20, called from __imp__sub_821D7DE0, called from __imp___xstart -- the entry thread itself), after several successful vd drain/vd swap cycles. Verified NOT caused by r435's own changes: reproduces with tracing disabled, reproduces after reverting native_guest_vd.cpp to the exact r432 commit (d7dc1682) and rebuilding, and reproduced 3/3 consecutive runs. This directly contradicts r431/r432's repeated claim of presented_frames=5 state=2 with clean exit=0 -- either an intermittent timing-dependent crash that existing runs simply never triggered, or something changed in the execution environment; either way it is now reproducible and was not previously reported. Not root-caused this cycle (no disassembly done yet). Named for r436, high priority: disassemble/live-capture sub_821D6C20 and sub_821D7DE0 (same gdb technique as r412/r426/r420-r424) before resuming any further presentation-content work -- until root-caused, do not trust 'chain closed' claims for a full-length run. The wider native/ backlog commit decision (r433) remains open, unrelated to this.
